lines.en: Not quick, but steady.
One wet print per step.

lines.zh: 我钻过缝隙，身形拉得很长。
lines.en: I squeeze through the gap, drawn out long.

lines.zh: 这具身体轻得几乎没重量。
lines.en: This body weighs almost nothing.
I walk around your feet.
A tendril probes, then the body follows.

lines.zh: 泥水把我的痕迹盖住了。
lines.en: Muddy water covers my trail.

lines.zh: 我贴着你留下的脚印走。
lines.en: I walk inside your footprints.

lines.zh: 小小的一团，不容易看见。
lines.en: A small lump — easy to miss.
Sliding slowly into the shade.
I curl up like a stone.
My surface pulses faintly.
Waiting for someone to pass.
There's enough damp here to last.
I have almost no shape.

lines.zh: 我在听泥土下面的声音。
lines.en: Listening to sounds under the soil.
A small body needs little.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你发现不了。
lines.en: Still as this, you won't notice me.
My color matches the ground.
Gathering myself, slowly.
This lump of flesh twitches.
This lump of flesh has no lungs.
Stillness is the safest thing.
Waiting for the next high tide.

lines.zh: 我把自己摊得很薄很薄。
lines.en: I spread myself very, very thin.

lines.zh: 不会有人记得我这么小。
lines.en: No one remembers something this small.
You'll have to crouch to find me.
Don't step — I'm right here.
I smell the mud on your feet.
What are you looking for down there?
I'm this small, and you still guard?
Your boot tip is about to touch me.
I've memorized the sole of your boot.
You want to kick me, don't you.
Looking up at you is tiring.
Someone noticed me.
Don't laugh; I understand you.
Don't poke me with that stick.
Part of me got squashed.
Half scattered, then gathered back.
It hurts. It really hurts.

lines.zh: 这一下把我拍成了两摊。
lines.en: That blow splashed me into two puddles.
I curl up to protect myself.
Slime everywhere.
The blow splatters a puddle of me outward.
I can still move. Don't step.
Breaking me apart won't help.
I'll come back up again.
Such a small piece? Give it here.
I eat very little in a meal.
A little raw smell is enough.
Don't throw it far. I'm slow.

lines.zh: 膝盖弯下来，离我近多了。
lines.en: Those knees bend, and now you're close.
I can't reach. A little closer.
Enough to grow an inch.
I'm not picky at all.
Drop the thing and step away.
Hungry too? You eat first.
You stepped on this lump of mine!
I'm stuck to your sole.
Don't shove me. I'll roll away.
I'm soft. Bumping won't break me.
You're between me and the mud.
You knocked me into the mud.

lines.zh: 我的身体被挤扁了一点。
lines.en: Part of me got squashed flat.
Don't grind me under your sole.
I slid out from beside your foot.
Pressed against you, it's warmer.
This lump of mine is still too small.
We multiply by splitting.
I don't understand what you're saying.
I only grow. I don't build homes.
Ask when I grow a second segment.
That question is too big for me.
I can't even look after myself.
Stop asking. I'm frightened.
The tide arranges such things.
I only want somewhere damp.
Just within reach. Good.
Curling a tendril around it.
Even something this small?
I drag it into the mud.
Too heavy. I can't move it.
Nowhere to put it anyway.
It's got my slime on it now.
I swallow it slowly.
Too dry; I can't get it down.
Leave it for someone else.
You stepped into my patch.

lines.zh: 我认准了你左边那只脚。
lines.en: I've fixed on your left foot.
Small I am, but I bite.
When you turn, I'll cling on.
The water here answers to me.
You walk far too loudly.
Your sole is three steps from me.
Let me get onto your boot first.
I've already wound myself on.
Try shaking me off.
A lump of flesh can jam a door.

lines.zh: 你每让一寸，我就贴一寸。
lines.en: Every inch you yield, I take.
Step down again and it's too late.
This lump is very sticky.

lines.zh: 我已经贴在你影子里了。
lines.en: I'm already inside your shadow.
Don't look down. Too late.
I circle your sole, looking for a gap.
You'll feel it first.
You're looking for where I am.
I'm behind your boot.

lines.zh: 你停下来，我就钻进石缝。
lines.en: When you stop, I slip into the stone crack.

lines.zh: 我在石头底下等你落脚。
lines.en: Under the stone, I wait for your foot to fall.
Your feet never stop.
When you stop, I climb.

lines.zh: 我爬得很慢，你不会注意。
lines.en: I crawl slowly. You won't notice.
There's still water where you stepped.
Keeping flat to the mud.
Further ahead is a mud pool.
My color matches the soil.

lines.zh: 你手上的火把照不到我。
lines.en: Your torch doesn't reach down here.
Waiting for you to crouch.
Your bootlace has come loose.
Going around to your other foot.
One more step and you're on me.
When you lift a foot is best.

lines.zh: 我这一团可以等你一整天。
lines.en: This lump of me can wait all day.
I know where your next step lands.

lines.zh: 你不会想到脚下有东西。
lines.en: You won't think of something underfoot.
I'm biting your ankle!

lines.zh: 我把酸液抹在你的脚踝上。
lines.en: I smear acid across your ankle.
A small bite — but it festers.
I'm going up your trouser leg.
Throwing my whole lump at you.
Water's gotten into your boot seam.
This one carries acid.
You can't shake me off at all.
Once I bite, I don't let go.
Kick me apart and I regroup.
I've stuck to the top of your foot.
You'll remember your soles after this.
Into the gap in your greaves.
Don't jump. It sticks worse.
I surface out of the mud.
A small lump, newly formed.

lines.zh: 这里的水把我聚起来了。
lines.en: The water here gathered me up.
Let me test movement first.
I was woken on purpose.
The ground is a little cold.
I'm a bit bigger than yesterday.

lines.zh: 周围全是没见过的味道。
lines.en: Everything around smells unfamiliar.
I rolled over in the puddle.

lines.zh: 一团湿的东西站了起来。
lines.en: A wet lump stood up.

lines.zh: 我落地时连泥都没惊动。
lines.en: I land without troubling the mud.

lines.zh: 这具身体很软，但不会散。
lines.en: Soft, but it won't come apart.
I see your shadow.
I don't look like any of you.
Someone dropped me here.
Bit by bit, I opened out.

lines.zh: 泥洼里，我慢慢凝出形状。
lines.en: In the mud puddle I slowly take shape.
I'll grow. Wait and see.
This lump of flesh is breathing.

lines.zh: 我又回来了，你没想到吧。
lines.en: I'm back. Didn't expect that.

lines.zh: 火把我表面的水都烤干了。
lines.en: Fire baked the water off my surface.

lines.zh: 从高处掉下来，摔成一摊。
lines.en: Fell from height and splashed flat.

lines.zh: 水太多，我这一团被冲淡了。
lines.en: Too much water diluted what I am.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹得到处都是。
lines.en: The blast sprayed me everywhere.
Something thin went right through me.
That light made my whole body hot.
I'm shriveling. So hungry.
Lightning struck and I shook like water.
Falling, and getting smaller.
